mentions.name: VyprSec
mentions.description: This tool performs autonomous vulnerability discovery and exploitation with zero false positives. It scans a whole codebase for possible vulnerabilities, ranks them, writes proof-of-concept exploits, spins up the software in a sandbox, and attacks it — all without human involvement. The final report contains only verified vulnerabilities with no noise, and it has already reported unknown vulnerabilities in open source projects.
mentions.problem: Vulnerability scanning is noisy and unreliable, producing false positives that require manual verification.
